newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso closes slightly higher at 1,063.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso closes slightly higher at 1,063.00.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 8 Reuter - Colombia's peso closed 0.30 centavos higher at 1,063.00 in quiet trading on the country's interbank market.

Dealers said most market players appeared to be keeping to the sidelines until Colombia's Constitutional Court formally notifies the government of a recent ruling overturning emergency economic measures it adopted in January.

The measures included a 6.0 percent tax on all new foreign loans, part of a bid to stem the flood of foreign capital that entered Colombia late last year and drove the peso to artifically high trading levels.
Dealers reported 278 trades for a below-average total of $110 million and said the peso held in a narrow 1,061.80-to- 1,063.20 trading range.
